newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian survives airliner blast, hit by bus.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian survives airliner blast, hit by bus.

text.p: A Brazilian who survived a fatal explosion on an airliner was hit by a bus soon afterwards and was fighting for his life in a hospital on Wednesday.
Mathematics teacher Leonardo Teodoro de Castro, 59, was in serious condition, a spokesman for the Sao Paulo Hospital said.
Castro was one of six passengers treated for light injuries on July 9 when an explosion blew a hole in the side of an airliner. Another passenger was sucked out and plunged to his death.
Castro was run over by a bus three days later.
"The day of the problems on the plane, he merely got a shock but now he will have to fight to survive," hospital director Jose Medina Pestana told local newspapers.
